Name: Persona Hairstyles
Author: Kuradjinou
Description:
Persona Hairstyles - 1.0.0


﻿INSTALLATION:
[spoiler]
    -Download and install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ if you haven't already.
    (It will also require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url].)

    -Download the mod.

    -Unzip the [b]PersonaHairstyles_100 [/b]zip file.

    -Place the unzipped folder ( [b][CP] PersonaHairstyles[/b] ) into the Mods folder (e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)

    -Start the game using SMAPI (StardewModdingAPI.exe in the Stardew Valley folder).

    -Play the game![/spoiler]



Last functionality test was on Stardew Valley v1.6.15.
If you have any troubles with the mod, leave a comment and I'll try to get back to you when I can.
-Kuradjinou
